blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Меня не ___ (выписать), пока я не выздоровлю.
exercises.prompt: I won't be discharged until I'm cured.
exercises.why: **выписать → выпишут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Who will the jury believe?
exercises.why: **поверить → поверят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Would you mind opening the window?
exercises.why: **затруднить → затруднит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's move the sofa.
exercises.why: **передвинуть → передвинем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Выпьем, ___ (закусить), о делах наших скорбных покалякаем.
exercises.prompt: Let's drink, eat, and talk about our woeful deeds.
exercises.why: **закусить → закусим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (расстрелять) каждого, кто усомнится в моём милосердии.
exercises.prompt: I will shoot anyone who questions my mercy.
exercises.why: **расстрелять → расстреляю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Stop the advance of the enemy.
exercises.why: **остановить → Остановите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Don't tell Tom. He'll tell everyone.
exercises.why: **разболтать → разболтает** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I think Tom will swim.
exercises.why: **поплыть → поплывёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll try to change their minds.
exercises.why: **попробовать → попробую** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Am I going to bleed to death?
exercises.why: **истечь → истеку** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's do a little exercise.
exercises.why: **потренироваться → потренируемся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Как только ___ (закипеть), дайте покипеть ещё около пятнадцати минут.
exercises.prompt: Once it starts boiling, let it boil for about fifteen more minutes.
exercises.why: **закипеть → закипит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Велосипед ___ (заржаветь), если ты оставишь его под дождём.
exercises.prompt: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
exercises.why: **заржаветь → заржавеет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll take you to school.
exercises.why: **отвести → отведу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Why don't we slow down?
exercises.why: **сбавить → сбавим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Как громко ни кричи "У-у!", в волка не ___ (превратиться).
exercises.prompt: Regardless how loud you scream "Oo-oo!", you won't turn into a wolf.
exercises.why: **превратиться → превратишься** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я не думаю, что эти чернильные пятна ___ (отстираться).
exercises.prompt: I don't think these ink stains will come off.
exercises.why: **отстираться → отстираются** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (сложить) этот листок пополам вертикально, потом горизонтально.
exercises.prompt: Fold this sheet in half vertically and horizontally.
exercises.why: **сложить → Сложите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Run, or else you'll be late.
exercises.why: **опоздать → опоздаешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
